partnershipPlan: Two patient partners with insulin-treated diabetes review the dose table and the questionnaire; the diabetes nurse and a theatre manager join the progression review.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The clinic said halve it, the ward said stop it, and nobody told me what to do at seven in the morning.
items.implication: One written plan followed by everyone.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I skipped my insulin because I was frightened of going low with nothing to eat.
items.implication: The dose table must address fasting explicitly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I can put diabetic patients first in general surgery, but my orthopaedic colleagues cannot.
Composite paraphrase: We check the glucose; it just does not always get written down.
items.implication: A study chart and completeness as an outcome.

summary: Four composite voices on advice, fear of hypoglycaemia, theatre lists and documentation.
